blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Isabela town Vice Mayor Jeryll Harold Respicio tested negative for illegal drugs after undergoing a P28,000 test at a private hospital, following Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla’s call for him to undergo testing after his outburst during a council session. Respicio took a test at St. Luke’s Medical Center-Quezon City, saying it was expensive. “Jonvic, irefund mo ako. Ang mahal ng drug test,” he said in Facebook post. (“Jonvic, refund me. The drug test was expensive.”) READ: Respicio takes ‘extensive’ P28,000 drug test after Remulla remark Remulla earlier said Isabela Governor Rodolfo Albano III is addressing the incident involving […]...
